# Fenrir Docs & Vault

IT documentation and an encrypted credential vault. For teams who need runbooks, customer documentation and shared credentials in one secure place.

Fenrir Docs & Vault is one of the [Fenrir apps](../README.md): it runs on its own, with its own dashboard, from this
repository with `FENRIR_APP=docs`. It is free, self-hosted and released under the Apache License 2.0, as-is and
without support.

## What it does

- Knowledge base with categories, internal and public articles, templates and revision history (restore any version)
- Automatic documentation that keeps per-customer pages up to date
- Credential vault encrypted at rest with your own key
- Reveals need fresh authentication and are recorded in the tamper-evident audit log
- Per-customer access through roles

## Quick start

1. Fork this repository (or copy it into a private repository) and clone **your** copy onto a Linux server.
2. Point a domain name such as `docs.yourcompany.com` at the server.
3. Run setup and choose this app:

   ```bash
   deploy/setup.sh --app docs
   ```

   Setup asks for your domain, an administrator email and your organisation's name, writes `deploy/.env` with fresh
   secrets, and can build and start the server.
4. Open `https://docs.yourcompany.com` and sign in with the email and the password setup printed.

The [full guide](GUIDE.md) covers every step in detail, first use, each page, configuration, updates, backups and
troubleshooting.

## The dashboard

| Menu | Page | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| Home | **Dashboard** | The app's headline numbers and a way into each of its pages. |
| Clients | **Knowledge base** | Runbooks for the team and how-to articles for customers, with revision history, templates and automatic documentation. |
| Clients | **Credential vault** | Customer credentials, encrypted at rest. Reveals need fresh authentication and are audited. |
| Admin | **Settings** | Customers (tenants), users and roles, custom fields, region and holidays, webhooks, API credentials, approvals, the audit log and platform options. |

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Server | Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS on amd64 recommended), 2 vCPUs, 4 GB RAM plus 4 GB swap, 40 GB SSD. The server image is the same for every app, so the first build still compiles the agents once (it takes a while; later builds reuse it). |
| Software | Docker Engine with buildx and Docker Compose 2.24.4 or newer, Git, curl, OpenSSL, Bash, Python 3. |
| Network | A domain name (DNS A record) pointing at the server; TCP 80 and 443 open; SSH restricted to you. |
| Signing | Not needed: this app has no device agents. |

## Not in this app

Tickets and the client portal (the **psa** app), device inventory (**rmm**). Public articles show to customers in the PSA's portal when both run on the same server. To add another app later, switch to `FENRIR_APP=complete` (see [the guide](GUIDE.md#adding-more-apps-later)); your data is kept.
